description_ru: Автобус застревает в снежную бурю, и одиннадцать незнакомых людей превращаются в друзей. Рассказ о доброте в трудную минуту.
text:
The bus left Inverness at nine o'clock in the morning, and by noon the snow was falling heavily. Maya sat at the back, near the window. She was on her way to a job interview in a small town in the north of Scotland, and she was already nervous. Now she was also worried about the weather. The road disappeared under the white snow, and the driver drove slower and slower.

At half past twelve, the bus stopped completely. The driver, a big man called Mr Burns, stood up and told the passengers the bad news. A tree fell across the road ahead, and a second bus was stuck behind it. Nobody was going to move for at least three hours. There were eleven passengers, and the nearest village was five kilometres away. "I am sorry," he said, "but we are staying here for a while. Please stay calm and keep warm."

Maya looked around. Next to her sat an old woman with a large basket. Across the aisle, two students were playing cards, and a young father held a sleeping baby. There was also a tall man in a business suit who kept looking at his phone. "No signal," he complained loudly. "I have an important meeting at two o'clock. This is a disaster." Nobody answered him. The old woman only smiled and opened her basket.

"I always travel with food," she said. "My name is Agnes, and I do not like to be hungry." She took out sandwiches, a big flask of hot tea and a chocolate cake, and she cut the cake into twelve pieces. Even the man in the suit accepted a piece, and he said a very small thank you. Soon the bus smelled of tea and chocolate, and the passengers began to talk to each other for the first time.

After an hour, it became colder. The engine was off because Mr Burns wanted to save fuel, and the windows were covered with ice on the inside. The baby woke up and started to cry. The young father, whose name was Tom, tried everything, but the baby only cried louder. Maya was good with children because she had three younger cousins. She asked if she could try. She sang a silly song about a duck, and after two minutes, the baby stopped crying and started to laugh.

Then the students had an idea. They took all the blankets and coats on the bus and made a big pile at the front. Everybody sat together and shared the warmth. Agnes told a story about a famous snow storm in 1962, when she was a girl. It lasted five days, and her family ate only potatoes and jam. The man in the suit, whose name was Peter, listened to every word. After a while, he even told a joke, a bad one, and everybody laughed anyway.

At three o'clock, the snow stopped, but the road was still blocked. Mr Burns went outside to look and came back with red cheeks and good news. A tractor was coming to move the tree, and a second driver had phone signal at the top of the hill. Peter climbed up the hill immediately, in his shiny city shoes. Ten minutes later, he returned with a wet suit and a big smile. He explained that the meeting was cancelled for everybody because of the weather. "For the first time in years," he said, "I have no work to do."

The tractor arrived at half past four, and the bus finally moved. It reached the village at six o'clock. It was already dark, and all the passengers were tired and hungry again. Agnes invited everybody to her house, which was only two minutes from the stop, and she made a huge pot of soup. Maya called the company and explained the situation. The manager laughed and told her not to worry. He moved the interview to the next morning.

Maya slept in Agnes's spare room, under three blankets. The next day, she walked into the interview, calm and rested, and she told the manager the whole story. He liked it so much that he offered her the job before she finished her coffee. Years later, Maya still met Agnes, Tom and the students every winter, on the first snowy day, in the same village, and they always brought a chocolate cake.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Долгий звук в центре рта, как «ё» без «й»; губы не округляйте, язык расслаблен, r не произносите резко.
Дифтонг: широкое «а» плавно переходит в короткое «и»; второй элемент слабее первого.
Язык между зубами, как для θ, но с голосом; звук мягкий и звонкий, не «з» и не «д».

questions.question: Why did the bus stop?
questions.answer: A tree fell across the road.

questions.question: Who shared food with the passengers?
How did Maya stop the baby crying?
questions.answer: She sang a silly song about a duck.

questions.question: What happened to Maya's interview?
questions.answer: The manager moved it to the next morning, and she got the job.
